BACKGROUND

A little background

In her note for Serenade, sunwoojunga explains the title: she had long felt most of her songs suit night better than day, and the album’s songs, different as they are, all grew from love. The album notes describe the studio recording of “Run with Me” as a large-scale ballad led by piano and joined by a full string section.

INSIDE THE LYRICS

Someone who will go with you

  • Companionship
  • Exhaustion

The invitation to escape comes with room for exhaustion. The person being addressed can cry, move slowly and take the time they need. The speaker offers to accompany them without requiring an explanation of everything that has gone wrong.

There is also a return in the lyric’s imagined journey. Leaving can be temporary, a pause made possible by someone willing to stay beside you. That gives the reassurance a patient quality: the companion remains present through the difficult part, before anything is fixed.

ABOUT THE ARTIST / 선우정아

sunwoojunga

sunwoojunga brings pop and jazz into her work as a singer, songwriter and producer. Here she is on stage with “Run with Me”.

She was named Musician of the Year at the 2014 Korean Music Awards.
